about_the_game:
Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the home of all things Finndustries!

Currently the demo can only be hosted by me, Finn, as it's still in early development. This means you'll need to come by the Twitch streams if you'd like a chance to try it out yourself!

You play as little robots called Bytes, while I control a VR avatar.

Your basic function is to cause me as much pain and suffering as possible, as generally those make the best streams.

But there are also other things to do, such as playing minigames and hanging out with other fellow viewers!

So if this sparks your interest, make sure to come on by and give it a try!

content_descriptors.notes: The mature content is very cartoonish and playful, such as the avatar's head exploding, but shouldn't ever cross into the realm of disturbing or uncomfortable
